map.产品概念四维评分 + Van Westendorp价格敏感度测试(PSM)，自动: Four-dimensional product concept scoring + Van Westendorp price sensitivity test (PSM), automatically computing the optimal price range and concept feasibility.
map.📖 查看「产品概念评估与定价测试 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Product Concept Assessment and Pricing Test
map.请输入调研样本的平均反馈价格（元）: Enter the average feedback price of the research sample (CNY)
map.概念评分：新颖性/实用性/可行性/市场契合度各25%权重: Concept score: novelty/usefulness/feasibility/market fit each 25% weight
map.PSM模型通过四条价格曲线交点确定最优价格区间: The PSM model determines the optimal price range via the intersection of four price curves
map.最优价格 = 便宜曲线与贵曲线的交点（可接受价格点）: Optimal price = intersection of the cheap curve and the expensive curve (acceptable price point)
map.价格下限 = 太便宜与太贵的交点，价格上限 = 太贵与便宜的交点: Price lower bound = intersection of too-cheap and too-expensive, price upper bound = intersection of too-expensive and cheap
map.📚 深度解析：产品概念评分与 PSM 价格测试: 📚 Deep Dive: Product Concept Scoring and PSM Price Test
map.新品立项前给概念的新颖性、实用性、可行性、市场契合度打分，判断值不值得推进。: Before a new product is initiated, score the concept novelty, usefulness, feasibility and market fit to judge whether it is worth advancing.
map.用 Van Westendorp 四问（太便宜/便宜/贵/太贵）得到可接受价格区: Use the Van Westendorp four questions (too cheap / cheap / expensive / too expensive) to get the acceptable price range and optimal price point.
map.把概念分与价格区间放在一起看：概念强但价格区间窄，说明溢价空间有限。: Look at the concept score and price range together: a strong concept but narrow price range means limited premium space.
map.概念四维：新颖性 8、实用性 9、可行性 7、市场契合度 8 → (8+9+7+: Concept four dimensions: novelty 8, usefulness 9, feasibility 7, market fit 8 → (8+9+7+8)÷4×10 = 80 points → "excellent concept", weak link is feasibility (7 points), and technology and supply-chain justification should be done before advancing. PSM: too cheap 30 CNY, cheap 50 CNY, expensive 90 CNY, too expensive 130 CNY → optimal price point ≈ (50+90)÷2 = 70 CNY, price lower bound ≈ (30+130)÷2×0.6 + 30×0.4 = 60 CNY, price upper bound ≈ 130×0.7 + 90×0.3 = 118 CNY, acceptable range about 60–118 CNY.
map.概念评分的等级怎么划？: How are the concept score bands divided?
map.四维各 1–10 分，平均分 ×10 转百分制：≥80 概念优秀、65–79 概: Each dimension 1–10 points, average ×10 to a 100-point scale: ≥80 excellent concept, 65–79 good concept, 50–64 average concept, <50 weak concept. The per-dimension bar chart shows the specific weak link.
map.PSM 的价格区间是怎么近似的？: How is the PSM price range approximated?
map.标准 Van Westendorp 需求的是四条累计曲线的交点。本工具用简化近似: The standard Van Westendorp requires the intersections of four cumulative curves. This tool uses a simplified approximation: the optimal price point takes the midpoint of "cheap" and "expensive", the lower bound is the midpoint of "too cheap/too expensive" weighted by "too cheap", and the upper bound is "too expensive" weighted by "expensive"; suitable for quick scoping, for formal pricing use the full curves.
map.关于「产品概念评估与定价测试」: About the Product Concept Assessment and Pricing Test
map.产品概念评估与定价测试工具，结合产品概念四维评分（新颖性/实用性/可行性/市场契: A product concept assessment and pricing test tool that combines the four-dimensional product concept scoring (novelty/usefulness/feasibility/market fit) with the Van Westendorp price sensitivity test (PSM), automatically computing the optimal price point (OPP), price range and gross margin, and giving concept feasibility judgment and pricing suggestions.
map.产品概念四维评分（10分制转百分制）: Four-dimensional product concept scoring (10-point to 100-point scale)
map.最优价格点(OPP)与可接受价格区间计算: Optimal price point (OPP) and acceptable price range calculation
map.毛利率与价格弹性空间评估: Gross margin and price elasticity space evaluation
map.概念评级与定价建议自动生成: Concept rating and pricing suggestions auto-generated
